    B.sort(reverse=True)
    C.sort(reverse=True)

    # We use a max-heap, so we push the negative of the value
    pq.append((-v0, 0, 0, 0))

    visited = {0} 
    
    # Cache methods for slightly faster execution
    heappop = heapq.heappop
    heappush = heapq.heappush

        if j_next < N:
            state = (i << 36) | (j_next << 18) | k
            if state not in visited:
                v_add(state)
                v = B[j_next] * (A[i] + C[k]) + A[i] * C[k]
